meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 在 agent 容器里装上 anydoc CLI 后,Claude 能把本地的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档转成 Markdown 再读取,文件不离开容器。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附加的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等文档,又不希望上传到托管解析服务时触发。

howto.what_en: Installs the anydoc CLI in the agent container, so Claude can convert local Word, PowerPoint, Excel and similar office files to Markdown and read them without uploading them to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: When an agent needs to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel or similar documents without sending them to a hosted parser.

say_en.note: Confirm the absolute local path first.
